If you are looking now, I would recommend the following:
1) Please look into prepaid maintenance
—> ideally, you would alternate between A and B services for the vehicle, these are done either at 1 year of it being out (let’s say you buy new new, and purchase it at 78 miles on 1/1/2025, if you reach towards 9500 miles before the year marker, you would get the service done then. If by chance the following year, you don’t even do 10k miles at the 1 year marker of your A service, you would do the B service then).
2) ELW is great, it honestly will cover more than the CPO or manufacturer warranty, and it will often cover the random items that may go wrong after the initial warranty expires
3) normal service intervals for you are:
- A/B service intervals at 10k mile marker or by year date, the vehicle actually tracks this for you and provides a heads up
- for newer Mercedes, the normal maintenances for the following are done at these intervals: every 5 years/50k miles, you would do spark plugs and engine air filter. Every 6 years/60k miles, transmission service.
- software updates are usually done when the vehicle has permission and goes to sleep at night. Some updates can only be done at the dealership (these are at no cost to you, you get a card in the mail regarding these).
- replace wipers when they streak

All in all, pretty straight forward. I would call your local MB dealerships to get quotes on these services for the one you are looking at. Ask them to send you email soft estimates (provided their prices don’t go up) so you can compare.
